## Improvements

- [MAJOR] Bind setup qualification, rebut admission, and semantic scoring to the corresponding audit's successful execution outcome and exact output/session. Reject failed or unavailable outcomes regardless of retained prose. Add nonzero-exit and in-band-error regressions containing otherwise creditable query/rebut text, retaining their costs as non-success results.
- [MINOR] Use shared revision, complete inventory, and file-hash validation immediately before each worker imports the selected checkout in both harnesses. Recheck frozen harness bytes before later launches. Refuse mismatches before provider admission, retain affected slots as incomplete, and preserve completed historical trials. Add regressions that edit source or harness bytes during an earlier trial and verify refusal of the next affected launch.

durable_review_state.stakes: One trusted local operator and OS run the MCP server and signed-in reviewer CLIs. Repository, plan, provider and fetched bytes are untrusted static data; reviewers do not execute repository-selected code. Ordinary edits invalidate affected snapshot evidence and block/retry. Hundreds of files, tens to low hundreds of claims, three concurrent census lanes and sequential settlement; evidence useful within minutes. Existing CLI provider network and public HTTP capture boundaries. False clearance, authority errors and wrong evidence binding have high impact; recoverable blocking is acceptable. Exclude hostile same-user races, compromised OS, multi-tenancy, deliberately corrupted-state recovery and formal or universal performance guarantees.
